import asyncio, os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from telethon import TelegramClient
from telethon.tl.types import User

load_dotenv('/root/my-bot/.env')
api_id = int(os.getenv('TELEGRAM_API_ID'))
api_hash = os.getenv('TELEGRAM_API_HASH')

SEARCH_TEXT = 'Поки що на консультацію до мене вам зарано'

async def main():
    client = TelegramClient('/root/my-bot/user_session', api_id, api_hash)
    await client.start()
    me = await client.get_me()
    print(f'Акаунт: {me.first_name} @{me.username}')
    
    found = []
    dialogs = await client.get_dialogs(limit=500)
    print(f'Діалогів: {len(dialogs)}')
    
    for i, dialog in enumerate(dialogs):
        if not isinstance(dialog.entity, User):
            continue
        async for msg in client.iter_messages(dialog.entity, from_user=me, search=SEARCH_TEXT, limit=5):
            if msg.text and SEARCH_TEXT in msg.text:
                u = dialog.entity
                name = f'{u.first_name or ""} {u.last_name or ""}'.strip()
                username = f'@{u.username}' if u.username else f'id:{u.id}'
                phone = u.phone or ''
                found.append(f'{name} | {username} | {phone}')
                break
        if i % 100 == 0:
            print(f'Перевірено {i}/{len(dialogs)}...')
    
    print(f'\nЗнайдено: {len(found)}')
    for x in found:
        print(x)
    
    await client.disconnect()

asyncio.run(main())
